title: The City Ever-Shining
summary: In Dramatic Ages mode, enter a Golden Age with 20 or more excess Era Score.
author: hand
tips: Community guide: 'excess' means at least 20 above the golden-age threshold.
Unverified: the threshold shown on the timeline already includes Dramatic Ages adjustments.

steps.text: Bank era score late in the era
steps.detail: Hold back era-score moments (wonders, firsts) until near the era end.
